title: SO-GEN2 rotated-frame candidate (owner ruling O5, package R1): lunar spin-orbit, pi-free data, enclosed norms

frame.description: Q1 = q - phi, Q2 = phi, P1 = p, P2 = p + J (symplectic, unimodular)

scale_bits.description: S: every numerator below stands for N / 2^S unless stated

hamiltonian.description: H' with time scale c; modes of V are keys (2, 2-m)

embedding.description: K'(theta) = (psi + v/(2 pi), phi, p, p + J)

package.description: exact rationals of the g1_explicit binders: n, tau, rho, rhoinf, M, sK, sB, sT, mu, nu (ray margin), gbar, s, sigma_omega, c (time scale), gamma, E0, err (the error bound e)

threshold.description: exact gamma^4 rho^4 / isoC1 (Fraction): e < threshold <=> smallness

domain.description: certDomain: rho_H, P1 disc (c1, r1), P2 disc (c2, r2), iota and sup deviations

v_sin.description: [k, l, B]: v = sum b sin(2 pi (k psi + l phi)) over H = {k>0} u {k=0,l>0}, b = B/2^S; U1 = v/(2 pi)

p0.description: zero mode of p, numerator at 2^S (rounded nu)

p_cos.description: [k, l, C]: p = p0 + sum C/2^S cos(2 pi (k psi + l phi)), C = round(b lambda 2^S), lambda = (nu-1) k + l

J0.description: zero mode of J, numerator at 2^J0_scale_bits

J_cos.description: [k, l, N]: J = J0 + sum N/2^S cos(...), the rounded/truncated energy lift -p^2/2 - V_E; P2 = p + J

E_re.description: [k, l, N]: character witness E ~ exp(2 i v) over the full lattice, real coefficients N/2^S

character_witness.description: keys served, pinHalvings, pinOrder, pin error eps0

gram_inverse.description: approximate Gram inverse B (symmetric): full-lattice real coefficients [k, l, N]/2^scale_bits of B11, B12, B22

torsion_witness.description: 3x3 rational witness S ~ (bordered torsion average)^-1 at time scale 1 (divide by c)

enclosures.description: norms (DK, domain, H' majorant, Gram, torsion) and residual bounds (witness, rows, energy, G-J), time scale 1

checks.description: exact-rational verification of every g1_explicit parameter constraint (all true)

margin.description: c eta, e, threshold, eta/threshold, smallness ratio C1 e/(gamma^4 rho^4)

gate_GJ.description: B0, B1, B2, Br, Bc and their targets (design section 6, rotated P2 row)
